spawn_multi_process: spawn a single node multi-rank test function using torch multiprocessing with a shared init file
init_local_distributed_process_group: initialize a local distributed process group with nccl backend for single rank testing
ForkedPdb_set_trace: debug a forked multiprocessing child process by attaching a pdb breakpoint on a specific rank
PGConfig_dataclass: create a process group configuration dataclass with backend, world size, and gradient parallel settings
init_pg_and_rank_and_launch_test: initialize a process group and rank then launch a test method in a spawned process
